display_name: Nauti-Strata (PolyStrata build for Pascal and AVX-only CPUs)

support.note: NVIDIA GPU, GTX 10-series or newer, 8 GB or more, CUDA 12 driver. strata-poly calls cudaStreamCreate at start: no CUDA device, no engine (the CPU only holds the experts that do not fit in VRAM).

notes: Nauti-Strata 0.1.44.1 (github.com/festeraeb/Nauti-Strata, catalogue id nautistrata, the Stand bundle). `nautistrata-serve` is a one-line wrapper on lemond's PATH: exec <install>/venv/bin/python <install>/serve/server.py "$@" (the Stand's stand/start.sh does the same after writing strata-stand.json).
{model} is the run config the Stand writes (`strata-stand.json`: exe bin/strata-poly-avx2, args --model <gguf>, tokenizer, model_name, lib_dirs).

Same server as PolyStrata, so /v1/models has no owned_by; identity.unreported is set so the plane skips its identity check (refused at load without it, measured 2026-11-10). One-line fix in serve/server.py: add "owned_by": "polystrata" to the /v1/models objects, then set it here.
